claim: Zonal shift is a capability of Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC); enabling it registers the Auto Scaling group with the ARC zonal shift service, and during an active zonal shift the group treats that Availability Zone as impaired.

evidence.quote: Zonal shift is a capability in the Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC).
evidence.title: Auto Scaling group zonal shift

evidence.quote: When you enable zonal shift for an Auto Scaling group, the group is registered with the ARC zonal shift service.
evidence.title: Auto Scaling group zonal shift
Auto Scaling group zonal shift
evidence.quote: Then, you can start a zonal shift using the AWS Management Console, AWS CLI, or API and the Auto Scaling group treats the Availability Zone with an active zonal shift as impaired.
